$comment: Continuous opportunity + portfolio-intel overlay. Default OFF. Does not lower ChiefTrader quorum, does not enable QUANT or LIVE, does not call placeOrder. Scanning thousands of IEX symbols is intentionally not supported — Alpaca IEX is a bounded subscription feed (hard streaming cap below). Momentum rotation uses REST snapshots then hot-swaps into the remaining non-anchor WebSocket slots.
_tradePlanIdeasEnabledComment: 2026-09-05, explicit operator authorization (docs/audits/ARGUS_PREMARKET_TRADING_IMPLEMENTATION.md §11.6/§12): when true, TradePlanBuilder.emitTradePlanIdea() emits a real TRADE_IDEA_GENERATED for each PRIMARY-tier TradePlan built at PRE_MARKET - one independent vote into the existing ChiefTraderAgent consensus, same as every other idea agent. Still requires isLiveIdeaGenerationEnabled() (Autobot on) and the TradePlanBuilder pipeline-agent toggle. Off by default for any deployment that has not explicitly opted in. This reverses the prior default (shadow-only, see TradePlanShadowTracker) at the explicit, informed request of this deployment's operator, who was told plainly this thesis has zero hours of graded track record.
_maxActiveSubscriptionsComment: 2026-09-21 REVERTED 20->12 same day, real defect found in this session's own forensic audit: the 20 raise (see git history / ARGUS_ARCHITECTURE.md for the original reasoning) looked clean for the first ~86 minutes post-restart (0 errors observed), but a live observability_events query later the same day found 230 real MARKET_DATA_DISCONNECTED events over the following ~3 hours, EVERY ONE with reason 'symbol_limit_exceeded_recovered' - Alpaca genuinely rejects 20 concurrent symbol subscriptions on this account's real package/connection, not just the one-connection-per-account limit found earlier. The earlier verification was real but insufficient: checking 'clean' minutes after a change is not evidence of sustained stability - this is the same lesson as the 15s-timeout follow-up the same day (a fix that looked clean in isolation still needed re-verification under sustained real conditions). Reverted to 12, the long-standing, previously-stable value, rather than guessing a new number (e.g. 15) between 12 and 20 - determining the actual real sustainable ceiling (if higher than 12) requires deliberate bisection testing with sustained real observation, not another one-shot guess. Do not raise this again without that.
_moverPriorityScoreBonusComment: Phase 3 (Dynamic Market Data Allocation, 2026-09-02): additive priority bonus applied to a symbol's hot-swap score when it is a currently-cached, real, liquidity-screened Alpaca mover (getCachedMoverSymbols()) - blends that real external signal with SnapshotScanner's own intraday momentum score instead of letting the two discovery mechanisms compete blindly for the same scarce subscription slots.
_composableRankingHotSwapWeightComment: Universal Opportunity Discovery follow-up (2026-09-03): wires ComposableRanking's own persisted finalScore (0-1, real gap/liquidity/newsCatalyst/agentConfidence evidence, not just raw momentum) into the SAME hot-swap priority score blendedHotSwapScore() already computes - before this fix, runRankingCycle()'s richer 7-component score was 100% disconnected from which symbols actually receive a market-data slot; it only ever fed TradePlanBuilder/MissedOpportunityDetector. finalScore is 0-1, so weight 1.0 makes this bonus commensurate with moverPriorityScoreBonus (0.5) and typical raw momentumScore magnitudes (SCORE_WEIGHT_PCT/RVOL/RANGE) - a tie-breaker/quality signal, not a replacement for momentum.
_gapMoverMinAbsPctComment: Phase C (Universal Discovery Expansion, 2026-09-02): real intraday gap-vs-open classification computed from the SAME Alpaca snapshot data already fetched for the liquidity screen (dailyBar.o) - zero new API call. A candidate with |gapPct| at or above this is tagged gapMover:true in the Discovery Lineage Ledger - observability only, never a bypass of the price/dollar-volume/spread/ADV screen.
_gapPctMaxPlausibleOpenToPrevCloseRatioC: 2026-09-16 data-integrity fix: bounds how far dailyBar.o (today's session open) may plausibly differ from prevDailyBar.c (yesterday's real close, the SAME reference SnapshotScanner.ts's own already-validated momentum calculation requires) before the open is treated as data-quality-suspect rather than trusted. 20x is derived from documented market-data domain knowledge, not tuned to any day's observations: it comfortably admits the most extreme real single-session equity gaps (severe binary-catalyst biotech moves rarely exceed 300-400%, i.e. a ~4-5x price ratio) and common US-equity reverse-split ratios (1-for-10 is common; 1-for-20 is rare but real and legitimate), while excluding the two-to-three-orders-of-magnitude anomalies actually observed live (RETO 985%, MEDS 394%, PDYNW 356%, QCLS 342%, DLXY 315% - all consistent with a stale or near-zero reference price, not genuine price action).
_gapPctMinAbsoluteOpenPriceComment: Weaker fallback guard used only when no prevDailyBar.c exists to cross-validate against. An unambiguous near-zero floor (a fraction of a cent) that only a genuine data-glitch print could fall below - never a bound on any plausible real security price.
_rvolMoverMinRatioComment: Phase 27 (Universal Discovery Expansion follow-up, 2026-09-02): real relative-volume classification - today's already-fetched snapshot volume (dailyBar.v, same data screenAssets() already pulls) divided by the already-fetched broadUniverseAdvLookbackDays-day average daily volume (fetchAvgDailyVolumeShares(), same data the ADV gate already pulls) - zero new API call. A candidate whose volume/ADV ratio is at or above this is tagged rvolMover:true in the Discovery Lineage Ledger - observability only, never a bypass of the price/dollar-volume/spread/ADV screen.
_rankingThresholdsBySessionComment: Session-Aware Trading Architecture Phase 2 follow-up (2026-09-05, docs/architecture/ARGUS_PREMARKET_GAP_ANALYSIS.md's revised Phase 2 scope): ComposableRanking.runRankingCycle() now selects promote/reject thresholds by real MarketSession instead of one hardcoded pair for every session. Values are IDENTICAL across all three sessions by default - this only wires the session-parameterization mechanism the gap analysis called for, it does not itself assert that premarket should have a different (e.g. stricter, for thinner liquidity) bar than RTH, which would be a real tuning claim with no evidence behind it yet. An operator can differentiate these later once real premarket promote/reject outcomes exist to justify it.
_javaQuantScoreCandidateLimitComment: Session-Aware Trading Architecture Phase 3 follow-up (2026-09-05): javaQuantScore (ComposableRanking.ts) is now actually wired to a live caller - SnapshotScanner's once-per-trading-day PRE_MARKET plan-building cycle only (never the ~30s RTH ranking loop, which would multiply Java HTTP + bar-fetch cost by every cycle for no evidence-backed benefit yet). Bounded to this many top-momentum candidates (by the SAME deterministic pre-score already computed, before Java is ever called) - matches DEFAULT_TRADE_PLAN_THRESHOLDS' total tier capacity (primaryCount 3 + backupCount 5 + watchlistCount 15 = 23) rounded down, since a symbol outside that range cannot receive a TradePlan tier anyway. Zero cost when QUANT_JAVA_CORE_ENABLED is off (isQuantJavaCoreEnabled() gate checked first).
_momentumScanUniverseSymbolsComment: 2026-09-20 forensic-audit remediation: 'SQ' corrected to 'XYZ' - Block Inc. has traded under ticker XYZ on NYSE since its 2023 rename; the stale 'SQ' symbol was confirmed live to produce real IBKR error 200 ('No security definition has been found for the request'), not an entitlement failure.
_broadUniverseAssetsFetchTimeoutMsCommen: 2026-09-05: fetchTradableAssets() was sharing the same 15s timeout as every other single-symbol Alpaca call in this file, but /v2/assets returns thousands of rows - a fundamentally larger response than a per-symbol snapshot/bar/movers call. A live boot-time failure ('This operation was aborted') was traced to this timeout racing Alpaca's full response. Raised only for this one bulk call; every other fetchJson() call site in this file keeps its own 15000ms.
_broadUniverseFairnessWindowCyclesCommen: 2026-09-16 subscription-starvation fix: real evidence found 5 legitimate, liquid, materially-moving admitted candidates ranked #99-#622 of 1,418 by raw dollar volume, never once inside the old top-20-by-volume window on an ordinary day. This bounds how many consecutive scan cycles (roughly ~15min cadence observed live) an eligible-but-unselected candidate can be skipped before its aging bonus guarantees selection over even the highest-liquidity-rank competitor - 20 cycles is roughly a trading-day's worth of scan cadence, a deliberate, moderate bound (not tuned to any specific day's winners).
_broadUniverseAllocatorMaxTrackedRecords: Bounds BroadUniverseSubscriptionAllocator.ts's in-memory tracking map. Set above broadUniverseMaxCandidates (200) with headroom so genuinely still-admitted candidates are never evicted mid-session purely from map size pressure.
honesty: Continuous intelligence, not continuous trading. OpportunityDiscovery never emits TRADE_IDEA_GENERATED. Planner cap is MarketDataWorker.getEffectiveStreamingCap(): Alpaca/default uses maxActiveSubscriptions=12; ibkr_gateway raises hardCapOverride to ibkrConnection.maxMarketDataLines (90). When emptySlots>0, Discovery fills up to maxNewSubscriptionsPerCycle (20) per scan. OpportunityScreener ideas need ARGUS_OPPORTUNITY_IDEAS_ENABLED (one vote — consensus 0.75/min-2 unchanged). Missed-opportunity detection (Phase 4F) is diagnostic-only: it classifies where a PROMOTE-recommended candidate stalled in the funnel using existing telemetry, and never emits a trade idea or affects sizing/consensus.
